root_causes_closed: Equipment UI had independent fields for facts that should be derived or selected once, allowing contradictory duplicate entry.
Equipment layer clear() overrode/reset values owned by the main form after reset, creating competing state writers.
Stabilizer self-mass could be inferred from a model group without binding the chosen length to the matching variant.
Fixed V-Bar geometry was represented by variant plus separate type/out/down fields, asking for the same fact repeatedly.
Nock/vane/bushing pickers contained hard-coded options and a catalog optgroup at the same time, creating two sources of truth.
Sight mass physically belonged with the sight but was presented in the Stabilizer section, obscuring unit semantics.
Legacy tests asserted one incorrect reset behavior and therefore protected a bug instead of preventing it.
implemented_changes: Riser Model remains separate from Riser Length.
Limb Model remains separate from Limb Size and Marked Draw Weight; manufacturer-specific options are used when known.
Added official Hoyt Carbon Velos Formula and Grand Prix catalog records with Short/Medium/Long and 22-50 lb in 2 lb increments.
Long rod, left/right side rod and extender lengths now use model-driven selectors with Custom escape hatches.
Catalog self-mass is matched to the selected model+length record; no borrowing from an arbitrary sibling variant.
Fixed V-Bar setting derives type/out/down once from its selected variant; adjustable/custom geometry uses progressive disclosure.
Sight mass moved beside Sight and continues to use real g/oz numeric conversion.
Damper identity and mass are co-located in Stabilizer Setup; duplicate Damper identity section removed.
Barebow added-weight fields are hidden unless discipline is Barebow.
Arrow ID/OD/GPI are catalog-locked when verified for the selected spine and editable for Custom/unknown cases.
Nock/vane/bushing menus are catalog-driven plus Unknown/Custom, with no parallel hard-coded product list.
Factory shaft length and catalog point reference remain reference-only; actual cut length/point weight are never overwritten.
Measured finished arrow weight is explicitly separated from calculated finished weight.
regression_gates: Shibuya 211 g converts to 7.443 oz through the actual conversion helper.
Selected stabilizer length resolves the matching catalog record and an unknown length resolves none.
40x15 V-Bar parses to Fixed / 40 out / 15 down.
Equipment layer is forbidden from clearing main-form riser state or disabling Auto AMO.
No duplicate IDs or relevant form names in Equipment Form.
known_limitations: Native macOS live UI acceptance still requires the user's Mac.
Some catalog models do not yet have exact mass/size ranges; those remain clearly Custom/Measured rather than guessed.
RamRods historical research remains Priority 1 and will merge forward from this catalog lineage.
